verdict.rationale: LibreOffice's core source is public on GitHub. Its documented headless mode lets you run it on your own machines under the control of external clients through the API, and a community user confirms running it in Docker for PDF generation and format conversion. However, the pack shows no first-party self-hosting deployment path, and the browser-hosted WASM build is reported as slow and failing in Safari. missing for 10: official self-hosting/server deployment documentation, first-party container image or hosted-service setup guide, a reliable web-served build (WASM reported sluggish and broken in Safari).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Starts in "headless mode" which allows using the application without user interface. This special mode can be used when the application is controlled by external clients via the API.
Also runs it in Docker to generate PDFs from templates and normalize document formats.
Emscripten / WASM: Runtime: a browser with SharedMemory support (threads + atomics)
